tailoring.headline: Solution Architect – Digital eCommerce & SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java & APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, data flows and API integration between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Solution Architect – Digital eCommerce
cover_en.hook: Opella's mission to challenge how self-care works for millions and simplify health through digital innovation directly aligns with my technical background. With over 5 years of professional experience building and integrating large-scale enterprise e-commerce and digital platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in scalable architecture, REST APIs, and complex backend data flows.

bullets.label: End-to-End Solution Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management.

bullets.label: APIs and Integration Governance
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, while designing PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to synchronize global channels.

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Collaboration
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks across ERP, MDM, and Profisee platforms while collaborating directly with international technical and business teams.

bullets.label: Modern Development & Documentation
bullets.text: Maintained high-quality documentation and collaboration using Confluence and Git within agile workflows, performing code reviews and supporting production deployments.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am serving a notice period ending 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical expertise can support Opella's digital platforms.

tailoring.why_company: I am inspired by Opella's mission to reshape self-care for millions through innovative digital platforms. My background in delivering scalable enterprise e-commerce solutions, robust API integrations, and complex data flows aligns perfectly with Opella's goal of modernizing its global digital ecosystem and simplifying the consumer experience.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and API integration expertise to help Opella build scalable, secure, and integrated digital platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce, REST API, and integration experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the Solution Architect role at Opella. I hold a valid work permit in Germany and would love to connect to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Solution Architect – Digital eCommerce – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Solution Architect – Digital eCommerce position at Opella.

With over five years of professional experience designing enterprise e-commerce platforms, RESTful APIs, and complex data integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong technical expertise in aligning digital systems with business requirements.

I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid work permit, and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background matches your needs.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
